name: codexbot
description: Send Codex lifecycle notifications to one official QQ sandbox user.

interface.shortDescription: Send Codex status and final replies to QQ.
interface.longDescription: A local Windows companion that observes the current Codex app through lifecycle hooks and sends read-only notifications through the official QQ bot sandbox.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Codex normally; this plugin only mirrors lifecycle notifications to the paired QQ sandbox user.
